name: Card Nav
description: Floating pill navigation bar that expands on click or hover into a panel of link cards, with a spring-driven open animation, animated burger icon, optional logo and call-to-action button.
contents: Rounded bar with animated burger menu button and Menu/Close label
Optional centered logo link (image URL or custom node)
Optional call-to-action button, moved into the expanded panel on narrow widths
Expandable panel of cards, each with label, description and arrow links
behavior: Panel height and card entrance driven by a spring animation with adjustable bounce, speed and stagger
Opens on click or on hover, closes on outside pointer press, Escape, or link click
Cards animate in with rise, unfold or fade effect
Intro animation wipes the bar in from a pill shape on mount
Switches to a stacked single-column layout when the component is narrower than 560px
Link arrows swap with a diagonal slide on hover or focus
Skips spring motion when reduced motion is preferred
Supports controlled and uncontrolled open state
editableByProps: Logo, cards, card text, links, per-card background and text colors, call-to-action
Dark or light theme, glass or solid surface, accent color for the call-to-action
Open on click or hover, card entrance effect, stagger, bounce, speed
Card height, max width, Menu label visibility, intro animation, initial or controlled open state
Custom link component such as a router Link, link click handler

needsCodeEdit.change: Change bar height, corner radius, padding or gaps
Change theme colors or add a new theme
Change the Menu and Close words
needsCodeEdit.where: WORD_OPEN and WORD_CLOSE spans in the menu button
ArrowUpRight01Icon import and the two HugeiconsIcon elements inside ARROW

fixed: Requires @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons for the link arrows
Uses Tailwind arbitrary values and CSS variables set inline on the root
Listens on document for pointerdown and Escape keydown while open
Root is a centered block capped at maxWidth and does not push page content, the expanded panel overlays what is below
Bar height 60px, inset 8px, gap 8px, radius 18px and logo height 24px are hardcoded
Switches to stacked layout under 560px root width
Hover close has a hardcoded 160ms delay and hover is ignored for touch pointers
Stagger is clamped to 0-0.3, bounce to 0-1, speed to 0.2-3
Hover and click behavior depends on openOn, not both at once on touch
Without logo or cta, those slots stay empty
Links without href render as buttons
Burger label text Menu and Close and default aria labels are hardcoded in English

options.look: Translucent dark purple-gray panel with light text and a white call-to-action
options.useWhen: Navbar floats over a dark hero, dark landing page or photo background

options.look: Translucent light gray panel with dark text and a dark call-to-action
options.useWhen: Navbar sits on a white or pastel page such as a light marketing site
